summary: Share API: POST/DELETE /api/sessions/[id]/share creates/revokes snapshot share
description: New src/app/api/sessions/[id]/share/route.ts. POST: requireUser + ownership (WHERE id=$1 AND user_id=$2, 404 on miss like sessions/[id]); reject sessions with zero queries rows; build snapshot: all turns in order, rehydrate chunks_used bare ids -> rich citation objects via corpus.chunks JOIN AT SHARE TIME; snapshot session voice/mode/study_text_id + owner prefs scope into retrieval_scope; if an active (non-revoked) share exists for the session return it instead of minting a new slug. Returns {slug, url}. DELETE: sets revoked_at on the active share. Done: tests for ownership 404, snapshot shape incl rich citations, idempotent re-share, revoke.

resolution.test_function: persists a self-contained snapshot: rich citations, session settings, frozen scope
resolution.note: POST: ownership 404, idempotent re-share (one active share/session), 400 on zero turns, citations rehydrated to rich objects at share time via rehydrateCitations (extracted to lib/corpus.ts, sessions/[id] GET refactored onto it — its citations now carry id, additive), retrieval_scope = 5 scope fields only, slug = 16B crypto base64url with 23505 retry. DELETE: soft revoke scoped by share.user_id. 7 new tests; full suite 610 passed.
